name: application-match-history-row
title: Match History Row
description: List of match results with a colored left border and Win/Loss/Draw label, game mode and queue type, score, duration, and relative time.
useWhen: Showing a player's recent match/game history on a profile or stats page.
You want a quick-scan list where win/loss is immediately visible via a colored accent, not just buried in a table cell.
Distinct from a generic data table — this is a fixed row shape optimized for glanceable results, not sortable/filterable tabular data.
avoidWhen: Users need to sort, filter, or export match data — a proper data table is the right tool for that.
The activity isn't win/loss framed (e.g. general activity log) — use a generic list or Activity Feed instead.
responsiveBehavior: Each row is a single flex line; queue/mode text truncates or wraps first on narrow viewports while the result label, score, and colored border stay fixed.
accessibility: Win/Loss/Draw is conveyed by both the colored left border and a text label, never color alone.
The score is rendered in a monospace font for consistent digit alignment when scanning multiple rows.
Duration and relative time are plain text, giving context without requiring the user to interpret a timestamp format.

variants.title: Match History Row
variants.description: Four matches: a Win (18–12, Ranked Duo), a Loss (9–16, Ranked Solo), a Draw (14–14, Casual Squad), and another Win (21–8, Ranked Duo).
accessibility: Each row's result label text is the primary identifier; the colored border is a secondary, reinforcing cue.

variants.title: Match History Row (Dark)
variants.description: The same four match rows adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Border and label colors remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
